title: Sharpness conjecture for forbidden induced subgraphs and JEP decidability
statement: Let $H$ be a graph, let $S$ be a finite set of graphs, and write $\operatorname{Forb}_\subseteq(S)$ for the graphs containing no member of $S$ as an induced subgraph. **One-forbidden-graph sharpness conjecture.** Problem JEP is decidable for all finite sets $S$ containing $H$ if and only if $H\subseteq P_4$. The paper proves the if direction; moreover, $H\subseteq P_4$ is equivalent to $\operatorname{Forb}_\subseteq(H)$ being well-quasi-ordered under induced subgraph containment. The converse direction remains conjectural.
source_name: Daniel Carter, “On the joint embedding property for cographs and trees”, arXiv:2409.06127 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.06127

Status: **refuted** according to the source (as of September 2024). “Note that the converse to this statement is false, as we now describe.”
